content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Chief Technical Officer (CTO): PhD in Engineering from an institute or university ranked within the top 25 in the NIRF Engineering category. Minimum of 2 years' experience after award of PhD degree in Research/Scientific /Technical services.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Chief Technical Officer (CTO): Maximum age: 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Chief Technical Officer (CTO): Base salary of Rs 90,000 per month + 30% HRA (if applicable). Exceptional candidates maybe considered at Rs 1,00,000 base salary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Hyderabad Chief Technical Officer (CTO) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad) for filling up research positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Chief Technical Officer (CTO) under the CLEANZ CoE project at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Engineering from an institute or university ranked within the top 25 in the NIRF Engineering category, along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) post is 45 years as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a base salary of Rs. 90,000 per month along with 30% HRA. Exceptional candidates may be considered at Rs. 1,00,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Hyderabad CTO recruitment is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Candidates can submit their applications through the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications by a Screening Committee followed by a personal interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website link?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad at https://iith.ac.in or access the direct links provided in the important links section.
